overall_goal: Measure and transfer pre-made tabbouleh salad and salad seeds into a bowl

goals.description: Retrieve salad ingredients from the refrigerator
goals.rationale: The person opens the refrigerator, takes out multiple containers of vegetables, moves them to the counter, and closes the refrigerator.

goals.description: Unpack the salad containers and remove the sauce
goals.rationale: The person removes the plastic wrap from the vegetable container and takes out the smaller sauce container.

goals.description: Set up the kitchen scale and measure the salad
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a fork and a scale, zeroes the scale with an empty container, and scoops the salad into it to measure the portion.

goals.description: Transfer the measured salad into the serving bowl
goals.rationale: The person scoops and scrapes the measured salad from the container into the final bowl.

goals.description: Measure the salad seeds and add them to the bowl
goals.rationale: The person opens a bag of salad seeds, pours them onto the scale to measure, and then tips the scale to add them to the bowl.
